label: Человек
description: A 10-sentence usage card for человек with role, number, and case movement.

missions.phrase: В очереди стоял только один человек.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject, countable noun. 1. 'Человек' is the subject in the nominative singular. 2. 'Один' counts a single person. 3. A clean count-and-name starter showing the base form.

missions.phrase: Этот человек живёт в соседнем доме.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject with demonstrative. 1. 'Этот человек' is the nominative subject pointing at a specific person. 2. The demonstrative gives definiteness. 3. A high-frequency descriptive structure.
Strategic focus: Nominative subject in a scene. 1. 'Человек' is the nominative subject. 2. 'В комнате' sets a clear physical location. 3. A simple but very common existential structure.

Strategic focus: Accusative animate object. 1. 'Человека' is the accusative object (animate, syncretic with genitive). 2. 'Ждут' is the plural verb. 3. Shows role shift from subject to object without changing the lemma.

missions.phrase: У этого человека есть красивое имя.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Genitive of possession. 1. 'У человека есть' is the standard Russian possession frame, where 'человека' is genitive. 2. 'Имя' is the possessed thing. 3. A natural identity sentence.

missions.phrase: Я помог пожилому человеку на улице.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Dative recipient. 1. 'Человеку' is the dative indirect object, the person receiving help. 2. 'Помог' governs the dative. 3. A small sentence that is grammatically rich and socially useful.

Strategic focus: Instrumental with preposition 'с'. 1. 'С человеком' uses the instrumental after the preposition 'с'. 2. 'Разговаривать' gives social meaning. 3. A core pattern for interaction language.

missions.phrase: Об этом человеке говорят весь город.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 1. 'О человеке' is the prepositional 'about a person' shape. 2. 'Говорят' keeps the statement general. 3. Useful for discussion and reading contexts.

missions.phrase: Один человек — это ещё не люди.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Singular versus plural contrast. 1. 'Человек' (nominative singular) is contrasted with its suppletive plural 'люди'. 2. The sentence is short and memorable. 3. A good anchor for number training.

missions.phrase: Он очень хороший и добрый человек.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative predicate noun with evaluation. 1. 'Человек' is the nominative predicate noun. 2. 'Хороший' is a common evaluative adjective. 3. The phrase serves daily praise and description.
